proof_scope: Tau Python workspace host-call bridge receipt and capability-boundary coverage

claims.proves: the declared Tau Python host bridge positive and adversarial checks pass across repeated trials using the real project test runner and optional Jupyter kernel profile
claims.does_not_prove: full production sandboxing, #324 host bridge rollout in every scheduler backend, provider/model quality, Memory write/promotion, or arbitrary graph query authority

cases.name: python-host-bridge-live-kernel-regression
command: cd .. && uv run --extra python-workspace pytest tests/test_kernel_host_bridge.py -q

cases.name: adversarial-host-bridge-authority-boundaries
command: cd .. && uv run --extra python-workspace pytest tests/test_kernel_host_bridge.py -q -k 'stale_generation or binding_mutations or absolute_and_parent or symlink or graph_query or evidence_emit or undeclared or late_request'
